brief.zh: 分拣机要把零件分成三类：X、O 和 +。网络先给每类打一个分，分可正可负。把三个分变成三个概率：每个都在 0 到 1 之间，加起来是 1，分越高的概率越大。期望用的是 e^分 ÷ 三个 e^分 之和。
brief.en: The sorting machine has to put parts into three classes: X, O and +. The network first gives each class a score, which may be positive or negative. Turn the three scores into three probabilities, each between 0 and 1, adding up to 1, with a higher score getting a higher probability. The expected output uses e^score ÷ the sum of the three e^score.

hint.zh: 分可能是负数，直接除以总和会出错。exp 把任何数变成正数。
hint.en: Scores can be negative, so dividing by their sum goes wrong. exp turns any number positive.

after.zh: 这叫 Softmax：先用 e 的几次方把分变成正数，再除以总和。分差 1，概率就差 e 倍，最高分会被放大。分类网络的最后一步几乎都是它。
after.en: This is the softmax: first make the scores positive with e to the power of each, then divide by the total. A difference of 1 in score is a factor of e in probability, so the top score is magnified. Almost every classification network ends with it.

t.zh: 这一章最后三关，要搭一台零件分拣机：传送带上有 X、O、+ 三种零件，相机拍一张，机器说是哪一种。<level-ref to="4-19"></level-ref>看到，模型要在新样本上也准才算数。
t.en: The last three levels of this chapter build a parts sorter: X, O and + parts ride the belt, the camera takes a picture and the machine says which kind it is. <level-ref to="4-19"></level-ref> showed that a model only counts if it is right on new samples too.

t.zh: 三选一时，网络先给每一类打一个分。可分数可正可负，加起来也不是 1，不能直接当成「有多大把握」。
t.en: Choosing one of three, the network first gives each class a score. But scores can be positive or negative and do not add up to 1, so they cannot be read as "how sure" directly.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：把三个分变成三个概率，规则在说明里。要想的问题：负的分该怎么办？
t.en: Your task in this level: turn the three scores into three probabilities, by the rule in the brief. Something to think about: what should happen to a negative score?
